data.rationale: The 23 requirements, 24 accepted impacts, single backoffice wireframe and design chain, consumed CLI contracts, security boundaries, frontend implementation, verification, independent assurance, delivery tasks, dependencies, and preserved exclusions are accepted.

data.reason: The delivery plan is approved and textual wireframes are the first eligible task required to establish the global design gate.
The textual wireframe defines and validates all 15 screens, 64 actions, paths, states, requirements, security boundaries, accessibility behavior, and preserved exclusions for combined design review.
The approved plan and validated wireframe make the visual-design task eligible, and deterministic rendering is in progress within the global design gate.

The VS Code-native Sharp/SVG renderer, 23-artifact desktop and compact PNG manifest, guideline provenance, component reuse, lifecycle states, and visual QA are complete and valid for combined human review.
